# NEW 2026-11-23 v21.0 Module F: 12 Civilization-Flavored Parliament Issues (oe_gov2_parliament_issues.txt) (oe_gov2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v210_parliaments_cabinet.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 2 issues per new civilization parliament type, balanced 10-12y modifiers with real trade-offs.

# Royal Taille & Intendant Assessment (皇家泰伊税与督察清丈令 — French Estates-General)
oe_gov2_pi_fra_taille_ordinance = {
	type = country
	estate = crown_estate

	modifier_when_in_debate = {
		tax_income_efficiency = 0.06
	}

	potential = {
		OR = {
			parliament_type = parliament_type:oe_gov2_estates_general
			tag = FRA
			has_or_had_tag = FRA
			culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:french_group }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_gov2_mod_pi_fra_taille }
	}

	chance = {
		add = 8
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { parliament_type = parliament_type:oe_gov2_estates_general }
				value = 4
			}
		}
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = no }
				value = 3
			}
		}
	}

	wants_this_parliament_issue_bias = {
		add = 5
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = no }
				value = 10
			}
		}
	}

	on_debate_passed = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_gov2_mod_pi_fra_taille years = 10 mode = replace }
		add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
	}

	on_debate_failed = {
		parliament_debate_failed_effect = yes
	}
}

# Pragmatic Sanction of Gallican Liberties (高卢教会自主国事诏书 — French Estates-General)
oe_gov2_pi_fra_gallican_liberties = {
	type = country

		legislative_efficiency = 0.10
	}

	potential = {
		OR = {
			parliament_type = parliament_type:oe_gov2_estates_general
			tag = FRA
			has_or_had_tag = FRA
			culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:french_group }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_gov2_mod_pi_fra_gallican }
	}

	chance = {
		add = 8
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { parliament_type = parliament_type:oe_gov2_estates_general }
				value = 4
			}
		}
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { stability >= 10 }
				value = 3
			}
		}
	}

	wants_this_parliament_issue_bias = {
		add = 5
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { stability >= 10 }
				value = 10
			}
		}
	}

	on_debate_passed = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_gov2_mod_pi_fra_gallican years = 12 mode = replace }
		add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
	}

	on_debate_failed = {
		parliament_debate_failed_effect = yes
	}
}

	type = country
	estate = nobles_estate

	modifier_when_in_debate = {

	}

	potential = {
		OR = {
			parliament_type = parliament_type:oe_gov2_shogun_hyojoshu
			tag = JAP
			has_or_had_tag = JAP
			culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:japanese_group }
			has_reform = government_reform:shogunate
			has_reform = government_reform:daimyo
		}
	}

	allow = {
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_gov2_mod_pi_jap_sankin }
	}

	chance = {
		add = 8
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { parliament_type = parliament_type:oe_gov2_shogun_hyojoshu }
				value = 4
			}
		}
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { num_subjects >= 1 }
				value = 3
			}
		}
	}

	wants_this_parliament_issue_bias = {
		add = 5
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = { num_subjects >= 1 }
				value = 10
			}
		}
	}

	on_debate_passed = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_gov2_mod_pi_jap_sankin years = 12 mode = replace }
		every_subject = { add_liberty_desire = -5 }
	}

	on_debate_failed = {
		parliament_debate_failed_effect = yes
	}
}
